dim_1_core_thesis.premise: Human goal-directed execution is physiologically governed by an invariant, discrete biological capacity ceiling in the central executive network, rather than an elastic or motivational resource pool.
dim_1_core_thesis.paradigm_shift: Demolishes the legacy continuous-resource hypothesis and moralized willpower frameworks by proving that executive degradation is a discrete architectural bottleneck driven by extracellular adenosine accumulation.

dim_2_causal_model.mechanism: Dopaminergic tone in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex controls the signal-to-noise ratio of task representations. Sustained cognitive exertion produces localized extracellular adenosine accumulation, degrading inhibitory control and triggering subjective executive fatigue.
dim_2_causal_model.ratios_in_prose: Active unchunked semantic representations degrade catastrophically beyond an absolute limit of 4 plus or minus 1 discrete units. Operational state externalization must occur within 90 seconds, and sensory de-escalation requires a 4-minute reset interval.

dim_3_master_analogy.analogy: The Central Executive as a High-Speed Static RAM Register with Thermal Throttling: The processor can juggle exactly 4 cache lines simultaneously with zero latency; attempting to force a 5th item does not gracefully slow down throughput but causes an immediate cache flush and thermal throttling mediated by metabolic waste accumulation.

classifications.etiology: Elevated anterior cingulate cortex conflict signaling paired with low perceived reward expectation

failure_modes: Unchunked Multitasking Overload: Attempting to hold more than 4 concurrent operational variables triggers catastrophic working memory dump.
Metabolic Resistance Trap: Attempting to power through adenosine accumulation using caffeine or sheer willpower accelerates cognitive fragmentation.

algorithm: Step 1: Externalize all active working memory representations onto a durable physical or digital substrate within 90 seconds of task ingestion.
Step 2: Enforce a strict single-token execution policy, restricting the active workspace to exactly 1 primary goal token at any given moment.
Step 3: Trigger an immediate 4-minute sensory reset when subjective cognitive conflict or perceived friction crosses operational threshold.
verbatim_scripts: State Externalization Declaration: 'Active buffer full. Halting ingestion for 90 seconds to externalize working memory state before continuing.'
Single-Token Boundary Defense: 'I cannot process secondary task tokens until the primary active goal token is resolved or committed to disk.'
Sensory Reset Announcement: 'Anterior cingulate conflict threshold reached. Initiating mandatory 4-minute sensory reset protocol.'

dim_6_skeptic_box.pop_culture_distortion: Pop-psychology portrays cognitive stamina as moral grit or 'ego depletion' caused by systemic blood glucose depletion that can be solved by consuming sugar or practicing motivational reframing.
dim_6_skeptic_box.clinical_empirical_reality: Empirical fMRI and neurochemical profiling demonstrates that ego depletion is mediated by local prefrontal extracellular adenosine buildup and discrete structural capacity limits of 4 ± 1 items, completely independent of systemic glucose levels.

proposed_concepts.name: Working Memory Capacity Ceiling
proposed_concepts.definition: The strict biological constraint bounding unchunked active mental representations to 4 ± 1 items within the human central executive network.

proposed_concepts.name: Prefrontal Adenosine Accumulation
proposed_concepts.definition: The localized build-up of extracellular adenosine in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex during sustained cognitive control that produces perceived executive exhaustion.

proposed_concepts.name: Executive Overload Typology
proposed_concepts.definition: The three-tier diagnostic classification of executive failure modes consisting of Attentional Hyper-Focus, Cognitive Fragmentation, and Executive Paralysis.

proposed_relationships.description: Prefrontal capacity exhaustion accelerates local extracellular adenosine accumulation under sustained control demands.
